note: Rejudged 2026-10-17 after 7af5edbb7f. RFC 4456 Section 9 read in rfc/full/rfc4456.txt: "In addition, the following rule SHOULD be inserted between Steps f) and g): a BGP Speaker SHOULD prefer a route with the shorter CLUSTER_LIST length.  The CLUSTER_LIST length is zero if a route does not carry the CLUSTER_LIST attribute." The commit changed checkClusterListLengthTieBreak only in the four assertion 8 and 9 failures, which now pass the BIRD route dump through interoplab.WithSearchedOutput (bounded excerpt) instead of printing it whole; each still returns fail(n, non-nil error) on the same condition. Assertions 11 (ze and BIRD agree), 12 (the agreed winner is the origin's path with no CLUSTER_LIST, the absent-as-zero case) and 13 (ze decided at step cluster-list-length, so no earlier step separated the paths and step g would pick the other path) are byte-identical, so the scenario still fails on a non-compliant selection. The unit covers TestBestPath_ClusterListLength (both tags) and TestClusterListEntries are unchanged: SelectBest and SelectBestExplain asserted on shorter-list win, absent-as-zero win, step f precedence and fall-through to step g; clusterListEntries pins absent and empty as zero. The interop unit carries no discrimination record and was not rerun for this failure-text change. Verdict unchanged.
